newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends a bit weaker vs basket on zloty fears.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends a bit weaker vs basket on zloty fears.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed slightly weaker against the central bank's basket amid fears that problems around the Polish zloty could have negative impact on the region, dealers said.
They added that the forint also weakened against the dollar as the U.S. unit advanced versus the German mark.

"The forint distanced itself away by some 20 fillers from the central bank's resistance probably because the Polish developments," one dealer said, while another confirmed that the zloty's weakening might have been the reason.

The forint finished at 192.55/60 to the dollar, compared to 191.91/96 at opening. At the close the forint was some 20 fillers off from the central bank's bid compared to trading right on it at opening.
The Polish central bank intervened on Wednesday with zloty purchases and dollar sales to protect the Polish currency.

Dealers said the fact that the European Commission on Wednesday officially published its recommendations that Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Estonia and Slovenia should be invited to begin EU membership talks along with Cyprus next year, did not offset this fall.
